answers.text: "rank 78 fails C9; day_vol 1.24 under 1.40." A 1.40 volume bar is not my test; fill difficulty is NOT_SERVED to me. My test is C5 and C14: W 0.5% under 20-wk high 9>21, D HH/HL 0.5% under 20-day high, and V/AJG at highs as the Key Price pair. The H1 LH/LL I already carried as my case against. The trend and group stand.

"an extension, not a test, retracement or contraction break." My method buys the new high, not the test (C5, C16): W 0.91% and D 0.91% under the 20-bar highs, D HH/HL. Extension over ema9 30.0858 is why I watch the one-day danger signal (C7), not a reason to wait for a pullback I never buy. H1 LH/LL is a minor swing my record filters out (C21).

"template is all-or-nothing; 50-day under 100 and 200." The template is not my method. Mine asks for an established trend at a new high (C5): W 9>21 HH/HL 0.7% under 20-wk high, D HH/HL 0.7% under 20-day high, the Industrials pair at highs (C14). The long-average order is a weight on how young the trend is, not a failed test on my record.

"The 20-wk high is not the 52-wk high." Fair weight: from_52w_hi -7.13 means the longer high is still overhead. But C5 asks for a new high after a normal pullback, which W HH/HL 0.6% under 20-wk high and D HH/HL show; it does not require the yearly high. The 1.40 volume bar is not my test. I keep the support, held small inside one group call.

"day_vol 1.35 under 1.40; rank 57 outside top three." Neither is my test: fill difficulty is NOT_SERVED and a volume cut-off is not in my canon. On my test (C5) SWK is at the high: W and D HH/HL 0.9% under the 20-bar highs, 9>21. Rank 57 is why I hold it as the group's laggard; if it lags its peers that is my C14 revise signal.
